description: Free list of New Zealand general practices (GP clinics), or urgent care clinics, near a place, from Healthpoint. Use it when the person needs a GP, wants to enrol with a practice, or needs urgent but not emergency care. Each practice: whether it says it is enrolling new patients (yes; restricted = only some people, e.g. family of patients or people living nearby; no; does not apply = urgent care that does not enrol; unknown = the page does not say), the practice's own enrolment note, its fee table (the first fee table on its page, usually fees for enrolled patients by age, without and with a Community Services Card; with age, the row for that age), addresses, phone numbers, website, online booking link, languages, hours, the doctors listed there (doctor_ids for get_doctor) and the date Healthpoint says the page was last updated. In New Zealand most people enrol with one general practice: visits cost less once enrolled, and a GP referral is the usual way to a public specialist. Give place or name. Practices are not doctors, so this does not count toward the daily doctor limit. Enrolment and fees change often: tell the person to phone the practice to confirm.

age.description: The patient's age: each result then shows the fee row for that age.

enrolling.description: yes = only practices that say they are enrolling new patients; yes_or_restricted also keeps practices enrolling only some people (read enrolling_note). Default any (enrolling practices come first).

kind.description: gp = general practices (default; also nurse-led, online, student and rest-home practices, named so in each result's kind); urgent_care = accident and urgent medical care and after-hours clinics (no enrolment needed); any = both.

language.description: Language other than English the practice lists, e.g. 'Mandarin', 'Samoan', 'te reo Maori'.

name.description: Practice name or part of it, to check a named practice.

place.description: New Zealand city, suburb or region (e.g. 'Papanui', 'Hamilton', 'North Shore', 'Canterbury').
